description: This Java source file defines the CommonWidgetModels class, which contains nested classes and methods for managing widget models, parameters, links, images, and related utilities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic for handling XML configuration, parameter expansion, and callback propagation.

classes.name: AutoEntityParameters
classes.description: Handles parameters related to automatic entity data retrieval, including entity name, fields to exclude, inclusion of primary key and non-primary key fields, and whether to send empty values.

classes.name: AutoServiceParameters
classes.description: Manages parameters for automatic service invocation, including service name, excluded fields, and whether to send empty values.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image element with properties like source, alt text, style, size, and URL mode, supporting expansion with context.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink element with attributes such as text, id, style, target, URL mode, associated images, parameters, callbacks, and auto-parameters for entity and service integration.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Represents a widget parameter with support for static values, dynamic expressions, and field references, including formatting based on data types.

classes.name: ParameterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Parameter instances from map entries, converting values to string.

methods.name: getParametersMap
methods.description: Generates a map of parameters for entity or service auto-parameters, expanding expressions and filtering based on configuration.

methods.name: propagateCallbackInParameterMap
methods.description: Adds callback tokens to parameter maps if callbacks are present and propagation is enabled.
